overview.description: The Fidelity Fundamental Small-Mid Cap ETF (FFSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed, non-transparent ETF that invests in global stocks with small to medium capitalization. The fund utilizes the Fidelity non-transparent model. FFSM was launched on Feb 2, 2021 and is issued by Fidelity.

data.text: BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fidelity announces the launch of two new active ETFs and updates to three existing equity ETFs, available February 26, 2024.
